items.title: Kyler Murray: Out for Monday's game
items.text:
Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Saturday that Murray (hamstring) has been ruled out for Monday's game versus the Bills.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: DJ Moore: In clear for Week 9
items.text:

items.title: Deshaun Watson: Clears concussion protocol, still questionable
items.text:
Watson (concussion) cleared the concussion protocol Saturday but remains questionable for Sunday's game at New Orleans.

items.title: Pat Bryant: Activated from IR
items.text:
Bryant (ankle) was activated from injured reserve Saturday, but he remains questionable for Sunday's game in Carolina, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jordyn Tyson: Activated from injured reserve
items.text:
